_about: The statement check of the CKAN server's own ckan_datastore_search_sql, offered as ckan__ckan_datastore_search_sql (src/lib/mcp/pack-filter.ts, isOneSelectOrWithStatement), held to a real server. Each row was sent as ONE simple query (psql -c) to PostgreSQL 16.15 (postgres:16-alpine, standard_conforming_strings on), with a hidden statement written as CREATE TABLE hit_<id>(). postgres: "second" = it ran a second statement; "notSelect" = it ran a statement that does not begin with SELECT or WITH; "one" = it ran one statement that does; "nothing" = it ran nothing (postgresSaid is its first line). check: what the check decides. Driven by scripts/statement-check-postgres.mjs; driven again whenever the check changes.
